verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can set a time-to-live for audio and transcripts and opt out of the model improvement program, all self-serve from the dashboard. That directly gives control over retention, with automatic deletion when the TTL expires. An older community note that audio is used for training is general concern rather than a concrete contradiction, and the documented opt-out addresses it. Missing for 10: explicit on-demand deletion of individual transcripts/audio (e.g., API delete endpoint), in-depth retention documentation beyond a one-line summary, independent or hands-on corroboration.
